programme.title: The Call of the Isles
programme.desc: Fyfe Robertson air chuairt tro chuid de dh'eileanan na h-Alba air gheat, nam measg Muile, Eilean Staffa, Barraigh agus Bhatarsaigh. Chaidh am prògram seo a chraoladh an toiseach ann an 1963. Join Fyfe Robertson on a journey through some of Scotland's islands, including Mull, Staffa, Barra and Vatersay. First broadcast in 1963.

programme.title: Mach à Seo!
programme.desc: Ramsay visits the Campsies for a fun-filled holiday. Tha Ramsay a’ tadhal air Monadh Chamsaidh son làithean spòrsail.

programme.title: Suas gu Deas
programme.desc: Tha croitearan Uibhist a’ cruinneachadh airson a’ chiad fhèill uain den bhliadhna ann a Loch na Madadh, tha Ruairidh is Peter a’ dol a-mach a dh’iasgach agus tha Mòd Loch Abar a’ teannadh dlùth dha Còisir Ghàidhlig Bharraigh agus Sgioba Dràma Uibhist. Uist crofters bring their best lambs to the first sale of the year in Lochmaddy, while Ruairidh and Peter go out sea fishing. Mod week is fast approaching for Barra Gaelic choir and the Uist drama group as they get ready to compete. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Port Steòrnabhaigh
programme.desc: Based in the main port in the Hebrides, we follow the beating hearts of Stornoway Harbour. In her shelter, there is a bustling community to be found. In this episode, there is a health problem on board a boat that has come alongside, and we get a look at the progress of the new Deep Water Terminal. Stèidhte ann am prìomh port nan Eilean Siar, the sinne a’ leantainn cridhe Port Steòrnabhaigh. Na fasgadh, tha coimhearsnachd trang ri lorg. Anns a’ phrògram seo, tha suidheachadh slàinte air bòrd bàta a tha a’ tighinn gu cala, agus gheibh sinn sealladh air adhartas a’ Chalaidh Dhomhain ùr. Thig còmhla rinn ‘s sinn a’ leanntainn beatha ann am Port Steòrnabhaigh.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Màiri Anna NicUalraig le ceòl dùthchasach agus traidiseanta bho Celtic Connections. Mary Ann Kennedy presents a show with folk and traditional music from Celtic Connections.

programme.title: Prois Tartan/Tartan Pride
programme.desc: Ann an 1872 chluich Alba agus Sasainn a' chiadgheam ball-coise eadar-nàiseanta air an t-saoghal, a' cruthachadh sgeulachd aig a bheilbuaidh a chun an latha an-diugh a thaobhfaireachdain, cultar agus eachdraidh an luibsluagh na h-Alba. In 1872 Scotland played England in the first international football match in the world, creating the genesis for a story of emotional, cultural and historical significance that continues to resonate in Scottish society in 2014.

A performance by Mairi MacInnes and band at the 2025 Trad Awards. Recorded live in Aberdeen with Mi ’m Shuidhe Nam Ònar and Kin (Càirdeas) amongst the songs.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tha Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ oirbh chun a’ chiad latha de Belladrum 2025 is Natasha Bedingfield a’ nochdadh aig an fhèis airson a’ chiad uair air Àrd-Ùrlar Hot House. Choinnich an saoghal ri Natasha an toiseach ann an 2004, is daoine measail oirre sa bhad le a guth sònraichte agus òrain tarraingeach a leithid ‘Unwritten’, a choisinn aire mòr-shluagh an t-saoghail. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome you to the first day at Belladrum 2025 as Natasha Bedingfield makes her festival debut on the Hot House Stage. The world first met Natasha in 2004. She became instantly popular, with a distinctive voice and smash hits such as Unwritten winning fans the world over.

programme.title: Timeshift
programme.desc: A glorious national obsession is explored in this archive-rich look at the evolution of the weather forecast from print via radio to TV and beyond - and at the changing weather itself. It shows how the Met Office and the BBC have always used the latest technology to bring the holy grail of accurate forecasting that much closer - even if the odd messenger like TV weatherman Michael Fish has been shot along the way. Yet as hand-drawn maps have been replaced by weather apps, the bigger drama of global warming has been playing itself out as if to prove that we were right all along to obsess about the weather. Featuring a very special rendition of the shipping forecast by a Cornish fishermen's choir.

programme.title: China's Greatest Treasures
programme.desc: The Yellow River - running for almost five and half thousand kilometres from west to east - is known as China's mother river. It's hailed as the cradle of Chinese civilisation and over thousands of years, it has fed billions of people and inspired generations of artists. Alastair explores the Yellow River and discovers some of the finest artwork from its valley, to understand how this unique natural phenomenon is deeply connected with the identity of the Chinese and the roots of their culture.

programme.title: On the Front Line
programme.desc: Myanmar's civil war has claimed almost 100 thousand lives. In 2021, the country's military seized power in a coup - and after losing ground to rebel and ethnic groups, it's making a renewed push - carrying out the forced-recruitment of tens of thousands of conscripts - and employing new drone technology. The United Nations' human rights spokesman has condemned the military's tactics which he's called brutal, and he's said that civilians are paying a terrible price. BBC correspondent, Quentin Sommerville and camera journalist Darren Conway have spent time with rebel groups. This films contains some graphic scenes, including surgery and childbirth.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: The men's football World Cup begins in the US, Mexico and Canada. With matches being played in three different time zones, it presents an unprecedented challenge for the media. Alex Kay-Jelski, director of BBC Sport, Craig Hope, chief football reporter at the Daily Mail, and Daniel Storey, chief football writer at The i, set out their plans. Violent disorder on the streets in Belfast has followed a knife attack, with a Sudanese man who was granted refugee status in the UK in 2023 charged with attempted murder. Dan Johnson, BBC News correspondent, explains the challenge for journalists reporting from the ground. Russia's economic forum in St Petersburg played host to several Western social media stars. Influencers are now part of the messaging strategy for governments around the world. Samantha Berkhead, editor of The Moscow Times, and Evie Aspinall, director of the British Foreign Policy Group, discuss the reasons.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: Eighty years ago, an icon of travel first appeared from a Tuscan assembly line - the Vespa. Qasa Alom takes to Tuscany's roads on a vintage scooter to explore a region whose reputation as a playground for the rich and famous also hides a fascinating blue-collared history. Qasa meets the last few working Tuscan cowboys of Maremma as they gather in their cattle and explain how tourism is now their bread and butter; and he heads to the caves of Carrara to see the dangers and hard work involved in mining some of the most-prized marble in the world.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: Not long ago, artificial intelligence was being sold as a science-fiction reality, a force that could transform society, cure disease, and remake the economy. Now, the mood is shifting. The companies driving the boom are racing for investment while grappling with a tougher reality: AI is costly, unpredictable, and not yet profitable. Even some of its creators warn progress may be too fast, as public anxiety grows and political resistance takes shape. Is AI now at a tipping point - caught between financial pressure, technological risk and a rising backlash?

programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring Scarlett Moffatt, BBC Radio 2's Owain Wyn Evans, BBC Radio 1's Rickie Haywood-Williams and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring Scarlett Moffatt, BBC Radio 2's Owain Wyn Evans, BBC Radio 1's Rickie Haywood-Williams and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring Scarlett Moffatt, BBC Radio 2's Owain Wyn Evans, BBC Radio 1's Rickie Haywood-Williams and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.desc: Accusations fly when the housekeeper reveals she saw Jon desecrating her local chapel with ‘one of them’ last night. Nat desperately tries to undo a drunken mistake, leaving Jess and Dan alone together for the first time since the kiss.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group C between Brazil and Morocco from the New Jersey Stadium in New York. This is one of the standout fixtures in the group stages, with five-time champions Brazil facing a tricky test against the 2022 semi-finalists. Group C also contains Scotland. It has been 24 years since Brazil last won a World Cup, and they’ve gone out at the quarter-final stage at four of the last five tournaments. Can legendary coach Carlo Ancelotti end their drought? Morocco were involved in controversy earlier this year when they were beaten by Senegal in the final of the Africa Cup of Nations. Senegal had walked off after Morocco were awarded a controversial penalty but came back to win 1-0, only for the result to be later overturned and Morocco declared the winners.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group D between host nation USA and Paraguay at Los Angeles Stadium. USA, now led by former Tottenham and Chelsea manager Mauricio Pochettino, reached the last 16 as hosts in 1994. Despite reaching the knockout stage in four of the past six tournaments, they have only managed nine wins in 37 World Cup matches. Paraguay have reached the World Cup for the first time since 2010, when they reached a maiden quarter-final before being eliminated by eventual champions Spain. This is the ninth time they have qualified for the tournament.

programme.title: Trooping the Colour
programme.desc: Clare Balding presents live coverage of the world-renowned military spectacle from Horse Guards Parade in London. The Grenadier Guards troop their colour before His Majesty the King in a thrilling display of military precision, music and pageantry. His Majesty’s official birthday celebrations culminate with the traditional appearance of the royal family on the balcony of Buckingham Palace, followed by the annual RAF flypast in the skies over London. Michelle Ackerley speaks live to those at the heart of the day’s events, and Clare Balding is joined by special guest Gyles Brandreth. Audio-described commentary with Hannah French is available on Red Button and BBC iPlayer. There is also commentary-free, uninterrupted coverage of the live event in London on BBC iPlayer.

programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring Scarlett Moffatt, BBC Radio 2's Owain Wyn Evans, BBC Radio 1's Rickie Haywood-Williams and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Trooping the Colour
programme.desc: Clare Balding presents live coverage of the world-renowned military spectacle from Horse Guards Parade in London. The Grenadier Guards troop their colour before His Majesty the King in a thrilling display of military precision, music and pageantry. His Majesty’s official birthday celebrations culminate with the traditional appearance of the royal family on the balcony of Buckingham Palace, followed by the annual RAF flypast in the skies over London. Michelle Ackerley speaks live to those at the heart of the day’s events, and Clare Balding is joined by special guest Gyles Brandreth. Audio-described commentary with Hannah French is available on Red Button and BBC iPlayer. There is also commentary-free, uninterrupted coverage of the live event in London on BBC iPlayer.

programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring Scarlett Moffatt, BBC Radio 2's Owain Wyn Evans, BBC Radio 1's Rickie Haywood-Williams and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Blankety Blank
programme.desc: The legendary Blankety Blank is back! Bradley Walsh hosts as a panel of six celebrities fill in the blanks and help win brilliant prizes for some very lucky contestants. programme.title: Pointless Celebrities

programme.title: The Weakest Link
programme.desc: BAFTA Award winner Romesh Ranganathan puts eight more celebrities' general knowledge to the test as they try to bank up to £50,000 for their chosen charity. The celebrity contestants are Gok Wan, Sunetra Sarker, Kate Humble, Asim Chaudhry, Katie Piper, Dermot Murnaghan, Andy Day and Susie McCabe.

programme.desc: Accusations fly when the housekeeper reveals she saw Jon desecrating her local chapel with ‘one of them’ last night. On a group outing to an ancient temple, Zoe, Solomon and Jacob are caught in a terrible car accident that threatens to ruin not just the holiday but also their lives. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group C between Brazil and Morocco from the New Jersey Stadium in New York. This is one of the standout fixtures in the group stages, with five-time champions Brazil facing a tricky test against the 2022 semi-finalists. Group C also contains Scotland. It has been 24 years since Brazil last won a World Cup, and they’ve gone out at the quarter-final stage at four of the last five tournaments. Can legendary coach Carlo Ancelotti end their drought? Morocco were involved in controversy earlier this year when they were beaten by Senegal in the final of the Africa Cup of Nations. Senegal had walked off after Morocco were awarded a controversial penalty but came back to win 1-0, only for the result to be later overturned and Morocco declared the winners.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group D between host nation USA and Paraguay at Los Angeles Stadium. USA, now led by former Tottenham and Chelsea manager Mauricio Pochettino, reached the last 16 as hosts in 1994. Despite reaching the knockout stage in four of the past six tournaments, they have only managed nine wins in 37 World Cup matches. Paraguay have reached the World Cup for the first time since 2010, when they reached a maiden quarter-final before being eliminated by eventual champions Spain. This is the ninth time they have qualified for the tournament.

programme.title: Trooping the Colour
programme.desc: Clare Balding presents live coverage of the world-renowned military spectacle from Horse Guards Parade in London. The Grenadier Guards troop their colour before His Majesty the King in a thrilling display of military precision, music and pageantry. His Majesty’s official birthday celebrations culminate with the traditional appearance of the royal family on the balcony of Buckingham Palace, followed by the annual RAF flypast in the skies over London. Michelle Ackerley speaks live to those at the heart of the day’s events, and Clare Balding is joined by special guest Gyles Brandreth. Audio-described commentary with Hannah French is available on Red Button and BBC iPlayer. There is also commentary-free, uninterrupted coverage of the live event in London on BBC iPlayer.

programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring Scarlett Moffatt, BBC Radio 2's Owain Wyn Evans, BBC Radio 1's Rickie Haywood-Williams and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Blankety Blank
programme.desc: The legendary Blankety Blank is back! Bradley Walsh hosts as a panel of six celebrities fill in the blanks and help win brilliant prizes for some very lucky contestants. This time, he’s joined by Stephen Mangan, Kimberley Walsh, Jonathan Ross, Craig Revel Horwood, Fatiha El-Ghorri and Nella Rose.

programme.title: Pointless Celebrities
programme.desc: A special sport edition of the general knowledge quiz in which four teams try to come up with the answers that no-one else could think of. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and co-host Richard Osman, with contestants Steve Backley OBE, Roger Black MBE, Kelly Sotherton MBE, Sally Gunnell OBE, Ashia Hansen MBE, Jo Pavey MBE, Martin Offiah MBE and Gareth Chilcott.

programme.title: The Weakest Link
programme.desc: BAFTA Award winner Romesh Ranganathan puts eight more celebrities' general knowledge to the test as they try to bank up to £50,000 for their chosen charity. Round by round, the weakest link is voted off until the remaining two celebrities go head-to-head. Only one can win the prize pot for their charity. The celebrity contestants are Gok Wan, Sunetra Sarker, Kate Humble, Asim Chaudhry, Katie Piper, Dermot Murnaghan, Andy Day and Susie McCabe.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: Accusations fly when the housekeeper reveals she saw Jon desecrating her local chapel with ‘one of them’ last night. On a group outing to an ancient temple, Zoe, Solomon and Jacob are caught in a terrible car accident that threatens to ruin not just the holiday but also their lives. As Solomon admits his failings to Zoe, Jacob starts to suspect she is the one to blame for all this. Nat desperately tries to undo a drunken mistake, leaving Jess and Dan alone together for the first time since the kiss.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group C between Brazil and Morocco from the New Jersey Stadium in New York. This is one of the standout fixtures in the group stages, with five-time champions Brazil facing a tricky test against the 2022 semi-finalists. Group C also contains Scotland. It has been 24 years since Brazil last won a World Cup, and they’ve gone out at the quarter-final stage at four of the last five tournaments. Can legendary coach Carlo Ancelotti end their drought? Morocco were involved in controversy earlier this year when they were beaten by Senegal in the final of the Africa Cup of Nations. Senegal had walked off after Morocco were awarded a controversial penalty but came back to win 1-0, only for the result to be later overturned and Morocco declared the winners.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group D between host nation USA and Paraguay at Los Angeles Stadium. USA, now led by former Tottenham and Chelsea manager Mauricio Pochettino, reached the last 16 as hosts in 1994. Despite reaching the knockout stage in four of the past six tournaments, they have only managed nine wins in 37 World Cup matches. Paraguay have reached the World Cup for the first time since 2010, when they reached a maiden quarter-final before being eliminated by eventual champions Spain. This is the ninth time they have qualified for the tournament.

programme.desc: Clare Balding presents live coverage of the world-renowned military spectacle from Horse Guards Parade in London. The Grenadier Guards troop their colour before His Majesty the King in a thrilling display of military precision, music and pageantry. His Majesty’s official birthday celebrations culminate with the traditional appearance of the royal family on the balcony of Buckingham Palace, followed by the annual RAF flypast in the skies over London. Michelle Ackerley speaks live to those at the heart of the day’s events, and Clare Balding is joined by special guest Gyles Brandreth. Audio-described commentary with Hannah French is available on Red Button and BBC iPlayer. There is also commentary-free, uninterrupted coverage of the live event in London on BBC iPlayer.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police on Skye plan to raid an abandoned house that intelligence suggests may be a cannabis farm operated by a major drugs gang. Elsewhere on Skye, officers must deal with a nasty three-car collision that has resulted in multiple injuries, cars on fire, and the island’s main road being blocked for hours. And officers in Inverness give chase to a man who jumps out of a window.

programme.title: The Chief
programme.desc: The Chief embraces a new government scheme that offers ex-offenders a job in the police force. As the initiative gains momentum, he quickly finds himself extending second chances all round - not only to ex-convicts, but also to the environment and, most surprisingly, to his estranged daughter Ellen. The interview process is complex, and the chief gets grilled on live radio, but he is determined to make it work and appoint the right candidate for the position. Can Miekelson’s 'Miekiavellian' plans ensure that these second chances don’t become his only chance to save his job?

programme.title: Tommy: The Good. The Bad. The Fury
programme.desc: Tommy is hopeful that he could be fighting again soon, and he and Molly-Mae are spending more time together, so things are finally looking up for him. Then, disaster strikes when KSI cancels the night when Roman was due to be in the fighting, claiming illness. John is furious but decides the boys need cheering up so tells them he is taking them on a camping trip. Neither Tommy nor Roman share their father’s love of the outdoors but do their best to enjoy a night under canvas. Tommy is beginning to redecorate the house in the hope that Molly-Mae may move back in, and he does his first red carpet event since the break-up. At the event, he reveals that Molly has agreed to go on a trial family holiday with him to Dubai. Could they be returning reunited?

programme.title: Tommy: The Good. The Bad. The Fury
programme.desc: Tommy and Jake are heading to Budapest to shoot a promo and hopefully finally close the deal for his next fight. After 18 months out of action, Tommy will return to the ring, and he can’t wait to get back to what he does best. Even better, brother Roman will be fighting on the undercard, so both the Fury brothers will be in the ring on the same night. Back in Cheshire, work on the house continues in preparation for Molly’s return. Meanwhile, Tommy has precious time with Bambi before he has to leave her to go into fight camp. On the day Tommy is supposed to be flying to Hungary to start training, the money still hasn’t reached his account, so John calls everything off. Four days later, the money has finally landed, and the boys are in Budapest, training hard in fight camp. On a rare day off, we discover the importance of faith for the Fury boys and how in particular it has helped Tommy through his tough times. On Easter weekend, Tommy is reunited with Bambi for the last time before he gets into the ring - will his hand survive the fight?

programme.title: Tommy: The Good. The Bad. The Fury
programme.desc: It is Tommy’s birthday, but there is no time for cake. With just days to go before his long-awaited comeback fight in Budapest, Tommy is pulled in every direction, juggling press conferences, promo shoots and the pressure of proving he has still got what it takes in the ring. Fighting on the same bill as his older brother Roman, Tommy steps into the spotlight once again and puts himself to the test against a hard-hitting Bosnian heavyweight. In a high-stakes bout that could define his future, Tommy isn’t just fighting for his career - he is fighting for the life he is desperate to rebuild. Meanwhile, there is a more personal battle quietly playing out at home. With the house freshly prepared for Molly-Mae and Bambi’s return, Tommy hopes he has done enough to prove he has changed. But now that he may have won them back, can he keep them?

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May test the Aston Martin Rapide, the Porsche Panamera Turbo and the Maserati Quattroporte as they attempt to find the world's greatest four-seat supercar. After an early morning start in the City of London, the boys embark on a road trip across the south of England, stop off for a race around a closed-off business park, and end up undertaking a rather special chauffeuring job. Meanwhile, Richard is on the test track in two very different muscle cars, the Chevrolet Camaro SS and Mercedes E63 AMG. And there's a double dose of celebrity as Harry Potter star Rupert Grint and F1 ace Rubens Barrichello take their turns as the Stars in a Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
programme.desc: The BBC's biggest comedy talent search heads to the stunning Queen’s University Belfast and Mandela Hall. This state-of-the-art live music, comedy and concert venue is situated in the heart of the University Quarter. Five acts will take to the stage in front of a packed house of more than 200 comedy-goers. Former NCA finalist Dane Buckley is our host. Joining him are the three judges – award-winning comedian and podcaster Alison Spittle, former NCA finalist William Thompson and head judge Fatiha El-Ghorri. Eoghan Collins, Pravanya Pillay, Vinny Shiu, Lianna Holston and Jim Midge will each perform their set before the judges decide who will go through to the grand final in November. There can only be one winner, so who will it be?

programme.desc: In the mysterious world of the Nethersphere, plans have been drawn. Missy is about to come face to face with the Doctor, and an impossible choice is looming... 'Death is not an end', promises the sinister organisation known only as 3W - but, as the Doctor and Clara discover, they might wish it was.

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: With Cybermen on the streets of London, old friends unite against old enemies and the Doctor takes to the air in a startling new role. Can the mighty UNIT contain Missy? As the Doctor faces his greatest challenge, sacrifices must be made before the day is won.

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Penny is threatening to cancel Miranda's Christmas if she does not sort her life out. Amongst other things, she forces her daughter on a detox. Stevie has a new executive job and Miranda tries to follow her into an office job, but it all proves too much. Meanwhile, are Gary and Miranda able to just be friends?

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Penny embarrasses Miranda by running for local councillor with Tilly as her wingman. Gary has put himself on the dating scene and Miranda decides she has to do the same - they both want dates for Stevie's birthday party. Will they find partners or end up back in each other's company? The result is a big surprise for Stevie.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: Suspicion surrounds Cathy’s creepy boyfriend, Boris. Buster and Dermot are convinced he is a vampire and hatch a plan to save Cathy, which leaves her mortified. Sharon has boyfriend troubles of her own, and Father Damien has been called away to tend to some depressed chickens. Meanwhile, Buster convinces Agnes she should have her antique vase valued. Who knows how much it could be worth? After all, it has been handed down through generations, and she plans to leave it to Cathy as her inheritance.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: Mrs Brown and the gang start the new year by attempting a tough new health and fitness regime. New year, new Agnes! But while Maria and Cathy work hard to get the gang into shape, a mysterious visitor to Finglas raises some difficult questions about Agnes and Winne’s past.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: The three funboys, Callum Brown, Jordan McCafferty and Lorcan Boggin, may have taken the scenic route through emotional development, but they’re trying to make the most of life in rural Ballymacnoose. While working at the local shop, Callum acquires his first-ever female admirer in the form of Gemma, who is new to town and seeking friends. Unfortunately, Callum’s burgeoning relationship means that he no longer wants to play video games all weekend with the fellas. This is too much for Jordan to bear and the PSNI are called to restrain him (again). Despite Jordan’s warnings about the devastating dangers of post-nut depression, Callum goes on his first-ever date. And things are going well until he gets an urgent call from Lorcan about a friend in peril: Jordan has jumped off a bridge in the village.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: After a gas leak at his flat, Callum moves in with Lorcan and his dad, Sammy, aka the biggest git in Ballymacnoose. Driven by a desire to no longer be a pushover, and in a desperate attempt to get over his break-up with Gemma, Callum goes under Sammy’s wing and unleashes his own inner git. Meanwhile, Jordan’s two dads are finally tying the knot, and Jordan is caught up in all the excitement of the wedding. But whilst Jordan’s attention is focused on suit fittings and stag dos, will Callum’s transition to full baddie cause an irreparable breakdown in the funboys’ friendship? And will there be any other disastrous consequences to Callum’s personality transplant?

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: With Callum now unwelcome at Boggins’ farm and his flat still out of bounds because of a gas leak, he turns once more to his oldest, dearest friend, Jordan. And things seem to be going well – Jordan’s two dads show Callum some much-needed sympathy and introduce him to the foreign concept of 'talking about his feelings'. Unfortunately, this new-found bond doesn’t go down so well with the other member of the house - Jordan. Meanwhile, Gemma brings home a pet and unwittingly causes Lorcan to relive some very painful memories. Will his emotional constipation cause their romance to founder on the rocks, or can he break the cycle of masculine silence and find a way to process his grief?

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Gemma and Lorcan throw a party at Boggins’ farm, and it’s the biggest social event in Ballymacnoose, with a whole eight people attending. One of those attendees is Gemma’s brother, David, who is tall, cool and very emotionally articulate. And weirdest of all, he seems genuinely interested in being friends with Callum. Has Callum finally found someone he can be himself with, who he can let his guard down with and who won’t take advantage of him? Meanwhile, Gemma finds one of her old personality quirks coming to the fore again as she struggles to maintain her identity amidst the intoxicating brew of Lorcan’s old-fashioned country charm. Will Lorcan pick up on his lover’s signals or barrel on as normal like a dumb pig? And while Callum focuses on his new friendship with David, Jordan decides to branch out himself and become mates with Frank. But can he handle Frank’s famously toxic banter?

programme.title: Queen and Slim
programme.desc: A young black couple, Queen and Slim, go on a forgettable first date together in Ohio. As Slim drives Queen home, they are pulled over by the police for a minor traffic violation - with a tragic outcome which forces the pair to go on the run together. The incident, which is caught on camera, goes viral, and people around the country track the escape of these two unlikely fugitives.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: A joint investigation by Panorama and the Times newspaper into the behaviour of David Sullivan, who has announced he is stepping down as co-chair and director of West Ham United Football Club. Over decades, he has made millions from pornography, newspapers and football.

programme.title: MasterChef
programme.desc: MasterChef 2026 has seen seven weeks of competition, all leading to this one moment: it’s the final, and one of the three exceptional cooks remaining will take home the trophy and have their life changed forever. Anna and Grace have chosen these three cooks for a reason, but to get their hands on the trophy, they need to pull out every stop imaginable – and a few more for good measure. The judges want each of them to prepare their best three courses possible in three hours. The plates must be technically perfect in terms of flavour profiles and execution, and crucially, they must show progression beyond anything served to date. Given the standard that each has delivered so far, all three of these standout cooks have what it takes to win, but it’s a question now of whether they can deliver what they envisage in the time allowed and under such immense pressure. Anna and Grace have the enviable task of sampling all nine dishes and will then choose which cook is worthy of taking the title. Get ready to witness three home cooks delivering plates that would not be out of place in some of the finest restaurants in the world. This is the final of MasterChef 2026.

programme.title: The Great Caruso

programme.title: The Importance of Being Earnest

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Featuring short-lease flats in London and Leicestershire, and a terrace in Larkfield in Kent. There are plenty of twists and turns as the projects get away, but do any of the developers manage to turn a profit?

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Join Natasha Raskin Sharp for today’s show from Builth Wells in Powys, Mid Wales. Experts Ben Cooper and Kate Bliss help two red and blue teams, who each have £300 to spend on three items. programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: The queen African honeybee rules the savannah - even elephants panic at the buzzing of her hive. This film recreates the life of the queen and her colony as they fight to survive. programme.title: Trooping the Colour

programme.title: 40 Originals at the BBC
programme.desc: Another celebration of the original outings of 40 classic songs that were so good, it was inevitable that they’d end up being covered by others. This is a playlist packed with familiar songs and unexpected moments, featuring artists ranging from The Osmonds to the Red Hot Chili Peppers, Randy Newman to Randy Crawford and David Bowie to Chaka Khan.

programme.title: 40 Originals at the BBC
programme.desc: If you didn’t know that Rockin' All Over the World is by John Fogerty and not Status Quo, or that Roberta Flack wasn’t the first to perform Killing Me Softly, then prepare for a night of massive musical surprises. This is a top 40 compilation of songs that became bigger hits for the artists who covered them - but here, we’re going back to the source material, serving up the incredible original versions, with artists including Gladys Knight, The Zutons, Neil Diamond, Nine Inch Nails, Dolly Parton and The Village People.

programme.title: Queen and Slim
programme.desc: A young black couple, Queen and Slim, go on a forgettable first date together in Ohio. As Slim drives Queen home, they are pulled over by the police for a minor traffic violation - with a tragic outcome which forces the pair to go on the run together. The incident, which is caught on camera, goes viral, and people around the country track the escape of these two unlikely fugitives.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: A joint investigation by Panorama and the Times newspaper into the behaviour of David Sullivan, who has announced he is stepping down as co-chair and director of West Ham United Football Club. Over decades, he has made millions from pornography, newspapers and football.

programme.title: MasterChef
programme.desc: MasterChef 2026 has seen seven weeks of competition, all leading to this one moment: it’s the final, and one of the three exceptional cooks remaining will take home the trophy and have their life changed forever. Anna and Grace have chosen these three cooks for a reason, but to get their hands on the trophy, they need to pull out every stop imaginable – and a few more for good measure. The judges want each of them to prepare their best three courses possible in three hours. The plates must be technically perfect in terms of flavour profiles and execution, and crucially, they must show progression beyond anything served to date. Given the standard that each has delivered so far, all three of these standout cooks have what it takes to win, but it’s a question now of whether they can deliver what they envisage in the time allowed and under such immense pressure. Anna and Grace have the enviable task of sampling all nine dishes and will then choose which cook is worthy of taking the title. Get ready to witness three home cooks delivering plates that would not be out of place in some of the finest restaurants in the world. This is the final of MasterChef 2026.

programme.title: Natural World

programme.title: 40 Originals at the BBC
programme.desc: If you didn’t know that Rockin' All Over the World is by John Fogerty and not Status Quo, or that Roberta Flack wasn’t the first to perform Killing Me Softly, then prepare for a night of massive musical surprises. This is a top 40 compilation of songs that became bigger hits for the artists who covered them - but here, we’re going back to the source material, serving up the incredible original versions, with artists including Gladys Knight, The Zutons, Neil Diamond, Nine Inch Nails, Dolly Parton and The Village People.

programme.title: Queen and Slim
programme.desc: A young black couple, Queen and Slim, go on a forgettable first date together in Ohio. As Slim drives Queen home, they are pulled over by the police for a minor traffic violation - with a tragic outcome which forces the pair to go on the run together. The incident, which is caught on camera, goes viral, and people around the country track the escape of these two unlikely fugitives.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: A joint investigation by Panorama and the Times newspaper into the behaviour of David Sullivan, who has announced he is stepping down as co-chair and director of West Ham United Football Club. Over decades, he has made millions from pornography, newspapers and football.

programme.title: MasterChef
programme.desc: MasterChef 2026 has seen seven weeks of competition, all leading to this one moment: it’s the final, and one of the three exceptional cooks remaining will take home the trophy and have their life changed forever. Anna and Grace have chosen these three cooks for a reason, but to get their hands on the trophy, they need to pull out every stop imaginable – and a few more for good measure. The judges want each of them to prepare their best three courses possible in three hours. The plates must be technically perfect in terms of flavour profiles and execution, and crucially, they must show progression beyond anything served to date. Given the standard that each has delivered so far, all three of these standout cooks have what it takes to win, but it’s a question now of whether they can deliver what they envisage in the time allowed and under such immense pressure. Anna and Grace have the enviable task of sampling all nine dishes and will then choose which cook is worthy of taking the title. Get ready to witness three home cooks delivering plates that would not be out of place in some of the finest restaurants in the world. This is the final of MasterChef 2026.

programme.desc: With the harbour master away, Penny Pocket tends to his beloved pet plant, Colin. But Colin is in a sad and droopy state - she needs to find a way to get him better!

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: On a hot summer’s day, Ginger and the Peas try to find the perfect spot on the beach.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: World-renowned botanist Chris introduces the Fact Pack to the Venus flytrap. They discover how this incredible plant catches its prey, including a very special trick it plays in the dark! They also find out about other extraordinary carnivorous plants.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Audrey is very good at sports! In this episode, she has a table tennis lesson with her coaches Tim and Harry. First, she practices some bat and ball skills before enjoying a rally against Harry (who is an actual table tennis champion!) Later, the whole family get sporty and have some fun playing mini-golf, and Audrey puts Mum through her paces with a very bendy yoga lesson.

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Stanley builds a feeder for Fifi's new bug friend, but the food is so good, it attracts lots of guests. It's time for Stan to build a bug hotel, so they can all eat, rest and have a lovely holiday.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Game Catchers are a team of five friends on an interstellar journey to explore fantastic planets, with the aim of learning about and playing new games. The discovered games are collected into a database to make sure they are never lost.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Odd Blocks are meeting for their special club. These Numberblocks are made of two with a one on top, and they never stop having fun. Numberblock One isn’t sure if she should be in the club - is she really an odd number? It’s up to her Odd Blocks friends to show her how important she really is.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red and Yellow meet new arrival Orange. Discover what happens when you mix red and yellow.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It’s a special day in the attic, but Rebecca seems to have forgotten all about it. Murphi has an inspirational idea for a 'bee-autiful' yogurt pot bee, the Mini Monsters transform paper plates into snappy-mouthed animals, and Rebecca gets a call from her uncle at the zoo. Finally, the Recycling Express inspires Murphi to help Rebecca turn different-sized cardboard boxes into a cake.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: On a chilly day, the Froglets enjoy camping outside with a tent, jumpers and marshmallows.

programme.title: Get Set Galactic
programme.desc: Two teams take on three scientific challenges based on sound and pitch, plants and the solar system. The team discovers that not all inventions need to be new.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create sock dog puppets using old socks and craft materials, learn British Sign Language signs for man, dog and home, then sing and sign This Old Man.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick and Norman are identifying the birds singing in the forest and hear a strange sound. It’s their broken cuckoo clock. Can the birds help them fix it by finding the missing key?

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes discover a new game - Pea-Rex Pinball!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Everyone in Sweetwood has an itchy nose, itchy eyes or the sniffles, but they are not sick. Vida knows that something in Sweetwood is causing the symptoms and finally figures it out—flowers!

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog and the doctors want to find Fergus a friend to cure his loneliness. Boom, Twiggy and Mara all try to be his new pal.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi promises her dads she will go straight to bed while Aunty T babysits. But when Aunty T suggests night-time ice cream, Rafi makes a wish and her bed magically flies them out into Manchester! It’s exciting at first, but soon Rafi becomes sleepy and wants to go home. Suddenly, the wish runs out and the bed drops onto a tree. Luckily, Aunty T uses her umbrella to magic them safely back. Rafi realises bedtime is bedtime for a reason.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo are playing the quiet game so won't tell Dad which toy to buy for Muffin.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.desc: It’s Halloween! Nikhil and Jay both want to win the family Boo Contest, but Jim is impossible to spook. Or is he? They just need to find the one thing that scares him...

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. When it is time for Tortoise to hibernate, Sarah and Duck help him find a quiet place to sleep.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: On a trip to the zoo, Lola is keen to buy a seal toy for her bath, but she has spent all her pocket money by the time she gets to the shop. In fact, Lola is having one of those days when she can't seem to save anything for later. Charlie helps out, as ever, and is later rewarded by his grateful little sister, who finally gets the hang of saving!

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Inside the little Toy House, everybody enjoys sharing books together. Mr Onion reads everybody a book that's all about how his friend Colly Wobble likes to be very silly. Colly Wobble likes the story very much - but what book is she reading?

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: BaBa finds a flower and wants to wear it forever - it’s BaBa’s forever flower. MeMo comforts BaBa when BaBa loses their precious forever flower. The Yummies help them look for it. They don’t find the flower, but they make a snack that's the same colours as BaBa’s forever flower to cheer everyone up. At the Lullaby Lake, a Tweetie arrives with BaBa’s lost forever flower. BaBa is very grateful.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Series for young children about a magical place inhabited by a community of toy characters that care for each other and have fun together. The Pontipines count up to five and go for a very long walk around the garden. As they pass by Upsy Daisy's bed, the children suddenly disappear. Mr and Mrs look through the binoculars and find them asleep in Upsy Daisy's bed. Only Upsy Daisy is allowed to sleep in Upsy Daisy's bed, and she returns while they are sleeping.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: A story read by a special guest. This Bedtime Story is read by Mark Bonnar and takes us on a journey around Scotland as we say goodnight.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot travels to Letterkenny in Donegal, often called Ireland's 'forgotten county', but quickly discovers a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. Surrounded by ancient rainforest, he heads into the woods to forage for prized golden chanterelle mushrooms before visiting the renowned Lemon Tree Restaurant, where he learns to make tortellini completely from scratch with one of Donegal's most skilled chefs. Dermot also meets Abdul, a Syrian refugee-turned-honey farmer, who teaches him how to extract honey from the hive and shares traditions from home, including how Syrians enjoy honey with strong coffee and a sweet dish called knaffe. Along the way, Dermot uncovers a county quietly building one of Ireland's most exciting food scenes, shaped by resilience, creativity and a deep connection to the land.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a pro. He then meets the Shine family, who produce beautifully crafted tinned fish using rare seasonal catches from the Atlantic. Over an unforgettable 'seacuterie' feast, Dermot discovers why Donegal's seafood scene is making serious waves.

With plenty of zing and a little bit of magic in every bite, Ainsley makes a Thai-style salad and serves up a special fish dish for classical musician Alexis Ffrench. JB Gill also joins him for a lesson in making the perfect fruit pavlova.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a pro. He then meets the Shine family, who produce beautifully crafted tinned fish using rare seasonal catches from the Atlantic. Over an unforgettable 'seacuterie' feast, Dermot discovers why Donegal's seafood scene is making serious waves.

programme.title: Josie's Taste Of The Westcountry
programme.desc: Proud Bristolian Josie Gibson takes us on a tour of her beloved West Country in a journey of celebration to discover dinner delights, freshly-caught lunches, the best of passionate artisan makers and growers and a few hidden gems to surprise us all - in this episode, Josie gets acquainted with the Cornish sea with a coasteering jump, meets passionate dairy farmers, picks fruit for chef Paul Ainsworth to make a delicious strawberry trifle and catches her own lobster for a scenic BBQ on the beach.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot travels to Letterkenny in Donegal, often called Ireland's 'forgotten county', but quickly discovers a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. Surrounded by ancient rainforest, he heads into the woods to forage for prized golden chanterelle mushrooms before visiting the renowned Lemon Tree Restaurant, where he learns to make tortellini completely from scratch with one of Donegal's most skilled chefs. Dermot also meets Abdul, a Syrian refugee-turned-honey farmer, who teaches him how to extract honey from the hive and shares traditions from home, including how Syrians enjoy honey with strong coffee and a sweet dish called knaffe. Along the way, Dermot uncovers a county quietly building one of Ireland's most exciting food scenes, shaped by resilience, creativity and a deep connection to the land.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot travels to Letterkenny in Donegal, often called Ireland's 'forgotten county', but quickly discovers a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. Surrounded by ancient rainforest, he heads into the woods to forage for prized golden chanterelle mushrooms before visiting the renowned Lemon Tree Restaurant, where he learns to make tortellini completely from scratch with one of Donegal's most skilled chefs. Dermot also meets Abdul, a Syrian refugee-turned-honey farmer, who teaches him how to extract honey from the hive and shares traditions from home, including how Syrians enjoy honey with strong coffee and a sweet dish called knaffe. Along the way, Dermot uncovers a county quietly building one of Ireland's most exciting food scenes, shaped by resilience, creativity and a deep connection to the land.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a pro. He then meets the Shine family, who produce beautifully crafted tinned fish using rare seasonal catches from the Atlantic. Over an unforgettable 'seacuterie' feast, Dermot discovers why Donegal's seafood scene is making serious waves.

programme.title: Josie's Taste Of The Westcountry
programme.desc: Proud Bristolian Josie Gibson takes us on a tour of her beloved West Country in a journey of celebration to discover dinner delights, freshly-caught lunches, the best of passionate artisan makers and growers and a few hidden gems to surprise us all - in this episode, Josie gets acquainted with the Cornish sea with a coasteering jump, meets passionate dairy farmers, picks fruit for chef Paul Ainsworth to make a delicious strawberry trifle and catches her own lobster for a scenic BBQ on the beach.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot travels to Letterkenny in Donegal, often called Ireland's 'forgotten county', but quickly discovers a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. Surrounded by ancient rainforest, he heads into the woods to forage for prized golden chanterelle mushrooms before visiting the renowned Lemon Tree Restaurant, where he learns to make tortellini completely from scratch with one of Donegal's most skilled chefs. Dermot also meets Abdul, a Syrian refugee-turned-honey farmer, who teaches him how to extract honey from the hive and shares traditions from home, including how Syrians enjoy honey with strong coffee and a sweet dish called knaffe. Along the way, Dermot uncovers a county quietly building one of Ireland's most exciting food scenes, shaped by resilience, creativity and a deep connection to the land.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a pro. He then meets the Shine family, who produce beautifully crafted tinned fish using rare seasonal catches from the Atlantic. Over an unforgettable 'seacuterie' feast, Dermot discovers why Donegal's seafood scene is making serious waves.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a pro. He then meets the Shine family, who produce beautifully crafted tinned fish using rare seasonal catches from the Atlantic. Over an unforgettable 'seacuterie' feast, Dermot discovers why Donegal's seafood scene is making serious waves.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot travels to Letterkenny in Donegal, often called Ireland's 'forgotten county', but quickly discovers a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. Surrounded by ancient rainforest, he heads into the woods to forage for prized golden chanterelle mushrooms before visiting the renowned Lemon Tree Restaurant, where he learns to make tortellini completely from scratch with one of Donegal's most skilled chefs. Dermot also meets Abdul, a Syrian refugee-turned-honey farmer, who teaches him how to extract honey from the hive and shares traditions from home, including how Syrians enjoy honey with strong coffee and a sweet dish called knaffe. Along the way, Dermot uncovers a county quietly building one of Ireland's most exciting food scenes, shaped by resilience, creativity and a deep connection to the land.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot travels to Letterkenny in Donegal, often called Ireland's 'forgotten county', but quickly discovers a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. Surrounded by ancient rainforest, he heads into the woods to forage for prized golden chanterelle mushrooms before visiting the renowned Lemon Tree Restaurant, where he learns to make tortellini completely from scratch with one of Donegal's most skilled chefs. Dermot also meets Abdul, a Syrian refugee-turned-honey farmer, who teaches him how to extract honey from the hive and shares traditions from home, including how Syrians enjoy honey with strong coffee and a sweet dish called knaffe. Along the way, Dermot uncovers a county quietly building one of Ireland's most exciting food scenes, shaped by resilience, creativity and a deep connection to the land.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a pro. He then meets the Shine family, who produce beautifully crafted tinned fish using rare seasonal catches from the Atlantic. Over an unforgettable 'seacuterie' feast, Dermot discovers why Donegal's seafood scene is making serious waves.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro closes the show but not before exploring what is coming next week at the Cellar Club! [S]

programme.title: Operation Bottleneck
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Edward L. Cahn. Stars Ron Foster, Miiko Taka & Norman Alden. Six paratroopers undertake an extremely dangerous mission against the Japanese.

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The...
programme.desc: ... Baim Collection. A Printer's Tale. 1960. A 'fact full' film showing the work at Leeds printer John Waddington, featuring pictures printed for jigsaws, boxes for toothpaste and enormous posters.

programme.title: Richard Diamond: Private Detective
programme.desc: The Hoodlum. 1959. Stars David Janssen, Russ Conway & Alan Reed. A mobster gives Diamond until 9 p.m. to turn over 'the book' or else Trumbo will have him killed.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Dr. Damon's Experiment. 1954. Stars Sandra Dorne & Laurence Naismith. An eminent psychiatrist returns home early from a conference to find his wife with another man, leading him to seek revenge. [S]

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Butterfly Winter. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Kenneth Cranham & Geraldine Gardner. Ash and the men of 347 Section tackle Hitler's latest deadly invention, the butterfly bomb.

programme.title: The Hi-jackers
programme.desc: 1963. Drama. Director: Jim O'Connolly. Stars Anthony Booth & Jacqueline Ellis. A lorry driver meets Shirley at a cafe and offers her a lift. His truck carrying valuable whiskey is later hijacked. [S]

programme.title: Runaround
programme.desc: 1980. Presented by Mike Reid. Prizes include a stereo record player, a stamp collecting game and a pocket camera. This episode features Falconers/Birds of prey, Customised cars (Jaguar XJS) and more!

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. The Princess's most trusted friend remains under arrest. Nina grows frustrated as Dean becomes more withdrawn.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Mortaise Fair. 1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Guinevere is presented with a priceless jewel but as a fire takes hold, the jewel is stolen. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Bloody Tower. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Glynis Johns. Batman saves Robin & Batgirl. Robin is stung by a Death Bee. Lord Ffogg & Lady Peasoup prepare to steal the crown jewels. [S]

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: The Ethan Allen Story. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Chris Wiggins. Ethan Allen and the Green Mountain Boys are at war with the ruthless tax collectors. [S]

programme.title: Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons
programme.desc: Renegade Rocket. 1968. Stars Cy Grant, Donald Gray & Paul Maxwell. When the Mysterons gain control of a rocket, Captains Scarlet and Blue must find a way to stop it before it reaches its target. [S]

programme.title: Champion The Wonderhorse
programme.desc: Medicine Man Mystery. 1955. Stars Champion, Barry Curtis, & Jim Bannon. Sandy investigates Ricky's wild tale of a medicine show operator who hides a small boy. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Cutlass Wedding. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Joan Sims & Maureen Davis. The colony girls threaten to leave after learning no one wants to marry them. Tempest attempts to offer them a new proposal. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Hero. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Bill Owen & John Dearth. After the sheriff's brother is killed, the man responsible is taken in by Robin, but tensions soon rise as he struggles to fit in. [S]

programme.title: Target Earth
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by Sherman A. Rose. Starring Richard Denning. A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Malta Milestone
programme.desc: 1964. A look at how Malta has sought new methods of generating income after the demise of the great naval dockyard. Also, a look at the future of the island before its independence day in 1965.

programme.title: Malta Story
programme.desc: 1953. War. Director: Brian Desmond Hurst. Stars Alec Guinness, Jack Hawkins, Muriel Pavlow, Anthony Steel & Flora Robson. British RAF face invasion on the strategic island of Malta during WW2. [S]

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Stage Fright. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Tony Wickert & Barry Linehan. Mowamba flats is the start of a new coach run for Cobb but some of the passengers do not appear to be what they claim. [S]

programme.title: The Long Arm
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Charles Frend. Stars Jack Hawkins, John Stratton, Dorothy Alison & Michael Brooke. The sleuths of Scotland Yard try to solve a series of burglaries. [S]

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Capture. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Christopher Benjamin & David Daker. Dick thinks Swiftnick isn't cutting it as a highwayman and Glutton and Spiker plot to lure Turpin into a trap. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Peter the Lett. 1963. Stars Rupert Davies, Marius Goring & Peter Illing. An alarming piece of news makes its way to Maigret - one of the most dangerous criminals in Europe is now in Paris! [S]

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: One Night's Grace. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Sally Osborne. Everyone is intrigued when an attractive young lady asks to see Lord Haslemere. Who is she and what is she after? [S]

programme.title: Honest, Decent and True
programme.desc: 1986. Drama. Director: Les Blair. Stars Derrick O'Connor, Richard E Grant, Gary Oldman & Adrian Edmondson. An advertising firm struggles through the launch of a new lager in 1980s London. [S]

programme.title: Fortean TV
programme.desc: 1997. Hosted by Reverend Lionel Fanthorpe. Tonight, investigate the curse of the shrunken sailor, meet the incredible floating nun and fall under the spell of a canine hypnotist.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Dead Part of the House.1959. Starring Philip Abbott, Joanne Linville and Mimi Gibson. After the death of her mother, a young girl makes friends with three mysterious dolls in the nursery... [S]

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1996. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. Meet Evio Botta, a 37 year old tramp who lives in Rome and runs his own Tramp University where tramps are taught the secrets of the trade.

programme.title: Brides of Blood
programme.desc: 1968. Horror. Directors: Gerardo de Leon & Eddie Romero. Stars John Ashley, Kent Taylor & Mario Montenegro. Tropical island natives must contend with man eating plants and animals! [S]

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot travels to Letterkenny in Donegal, often called Ireland's 'forgotten county', but quickly discovers a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. Surrounded by ancient rainforest, he heads into the woods to forage for prized golden chanterelle mushrooms before visiting the renowned Lemon Tree Restaurant, where he learns to make tortellini completely from scratch with one of Donegal's most skilled chefs. Dermot also meets Abdul, a Syrian refugee-turned-honey farmer, who teaches him how to extract honey from the hive and shares traditions from home, including how Syrians enjoy honey with strong coffee and a sweet dish called knaffe. Along the way, Dermot uncovers a county quietly building one of Ireland's most exciting food scenes, shaped by resilience, creativity and a deep connection to the land.
